help.title: Why single sign-on is unavailable
help.reason: When a sign-in finishes, Rocket.Chat leaves the result in the browser storage of its own address, {{server}}. A browser only lets a page read the storage of the address it was served from, so this client — served from somewhere else — never receives it. That is the browser's same-origin rule rather than a Rocket.Chat setting, and no option in Rocket.Chat can lift it.
help.fixIntro: Serve this client and the gateway from the same hostname as Rocket.Chat, with one reverse proxy in front of all three:
help.fixWebsocket: The gateway's WebSocket has to sit at /ws on the root, not under the gateway's own path: this client always connects to <address>/ws.
help.fixBuild: Then rebuild this client with the gateway's new address:
help.checkSiteUrl: Rocket.Chat's Site URL (Administration → Settings → General) has to match the address people actually visit. Rocket.Chat builds the OAuth callback from it, and the provider compares the two.
help.checkRedirect: At each OAuth provider, the authorised redirect URI has to be {{redirect}}.
help.fallback: Until then, signing in with a username and password works as usual.
